title: A US jury finds Huawei guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud but acquits it of the most severe charge of criminal racketeering conspiracy (Associated Press)
summary: Associated Press: A US jury finds Huawei guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud but acquits it of the most severe charge of criminal racketeering conspiracy — A U.S. jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies on Tuesday of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud …
